Coastal temperature effects

Source: R/workerfunctions.R
dot-tempcoastal.Rd

Coastal temperature effects

Usage

.tempcoastal(
  tc,
  sstf,
  u2,
  wdir,
  dtmf,
  dtmm,
  dtmc,
  ndir = 32,
  smooth = 5,
  correct = TRUE
)

Arguments

tc

  • downscaled temperature at same res as dtmf

sstf

  • downscaled sea surface temperature to dtmf resolution and extent - no NA and timeseries must match tc

u2

  • downscaled windspeed at temprature height

wdir

  • wind direction (coarse resolution) - same value for all of dtmf extent will be used

dtmf

  • fine dtm spatraster

dtmm

  • fine-scale dtm covering wider area than dtmf (but same resolution!!)

dtmc

  • coarse dtm spatraster matching resolution and extent of wdir

ndir

  • number of directions to calculate for wind exposure

smooth

  • number of cells to use for smoothing matrix

correct

  • corrects each timestep so that output mean temp of area matches input area mean temp

Value

Spatraster of temperature that includes coastal effect
